thread:
Maya: we need better visibility into routing decisions in Console. customers keep asking why requests drop to fallback model and cost spikes.
Ryan: +1. per-request attribution would help. think sampled telemetry first.
Deva: plan: auth resolver adds internal headers `x-rwd-auth-path` (enum) and `x-rwd-auth-hash` (hashed id). only emitted internally.
Sarah: put it at auth-proxy to avoid extra RPCs in hot path. don't change public API.
Katie: Console idea: add an "Auth origin" break-down on route page and a global rollup. small explain modal showing decision tree and link to trace.
Maya: rollout: start sampling 0.1% to measure cardinality. then 1%/10% before full rollout.
Ryan: metric: `billing.auth_path.tokens` with labels auth_bucket, model_variant, region. sample emission initially. cap cardinality.
Deva: will hash SA emails, emit stable short suffixes, keep full mapping only in traces/internal store.
Sarah: infra: enforce metric cap 100, retention 30d hot. add feature flag `auth_path_tagging` to control sampling.
Katie: docs: internal support FAQ + changelog note (high-level only).
Maya: owners: Deva backend, Maya Console, Sarah infra, Ryan alerts, Katie docs.
Ryan: alerts: page if top auth_bucket tokens change >20% vs 1h baseline for 5m, or unique auth_bucket count >200% growth in 1h.
Sarah: playbook: if we see spikes, flip sampling to 0 and rollback.
ops-bot: "deploy queued: auth-proxy v2 -> canary 10%"
Maya: let's reconvene in 48h after initial sampling. thanks.
